=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- README.md:line 3565 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Line 3565 says "Any uncertainty (`identity_unavailable`, `history_unavailable`, `unavailable`, `label_failed`) never trips; the legacy ladder keeps running and the next tick retries." But `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply` now logs `outcome=label_failed ... reason=label_read_failed` and returns 2, and both callers skip the ladder (`run_standalone_stall_recovery` `trip)` arm runs `continue` when rc is not 1; `run_managed_failure_fingerprint_breaker` adds the label to `LABELS_JSON` so `check-stalls` skips the issue). Line 3566 says the opposite.
  WHY: This is documentation drift and nothing breaks at runtime. An operator would expect a `/answer` or `/approved` retrigger for `reason=label_read_failed` and none is posted. Suggested fix: limit `label_failed` in line 3565 to the rc=1 case.
- NOTE (rejected pass-1 claim): scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh line 22728 (`_failure_fingerprint_breaker_check "${ffb_issue}" "${ffb_comments}" "true" "managed"`) is correct. The third argument is `cache_available`, and `ffb_complete` is "true" only for "complete", or for "true" with fewer than 100 cached comments. This is the same rule as `_staged_support_comments_for_guard` (lines 18133-18135). `_fetch_candidate_issue_details_graphql` (line 20207, `comments(last: 100)`) and the cache shape at lines 20264-20270 match the evaluator.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply`, the `reason=label_read_failed` early `return 2`, emits only a `::warning::` line. It does not use the plain `STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER issue=... outcome=label_failed phase= fp= runs= label=` form from agents.d/stuck-states-p3b-stall-breaker.md and sends no Telegram alert. Fix: print that line and send one `tg_notify_issue ... "WARNING"` (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. All deliverables are present. Writing the AI_FAILURE_FINGERPRINT_V1 markers belongs to sibling phase P3a.

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- README.md:line 3565 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The bullet at line 3565 contradicts line 3566 and the code. `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22627-22630) returns 2 with `outcome=label_failed reason=label_read_failed`, and both callers skip the ladder: the standalone trip arm (line 23164-23170), and the managed loop through `LABELS_JSON` (line 22735-22741). The rollback paths (`rollback=unverified`, `rollback=failed`) also return 2 and stop the ladder.
  WHY: Nothing fails in code, but an operator would expect a `/answer` or `/approved` retrigger in the `reason=label_read_failed` tick and could misdiagnose a stalled issue. Suggested fix: a one-line clarification.
- NOTE (rejected pass-1 claim): The openai_gpt-6-luna finding (orchestrate_poll_process.sh:22728) is incorrect. In `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_check` (lines 22542-22549), "true" is the last-100 cache case and is complete only when the cache holds fewer than 100 comments, so a truncated window gives `needs_full_history` and a full fetch through `_staged_support_comments_for_guard`. The only boundary effect is one extra full-history read at exactly 100 comments.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh `_failure_fingerprint_breaker_apply`, the `label_read_failed` early return (rc=2), lines ~22627-22630. It posts no breaker comment and sends no notification, so the issue silently sits with `ai:needs-human` and only a `::warning::` in the log. Fix: emit the `STALL_FINGERPRINT_BREAKER issue=... outcome=label_failed reason=label_read_failed phase=... fp=... label=...` line and one `tg_notify_issue ... "WARNING"` (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
